unresolved_critical_non_model_items.title: CLI and GUI preflight still rely on legacy v7 controls; v8 phase gates are not enforced
unresolved_critical_non_model_items.description: The CLI and GUI do invoke esonde_v7.preflight.run_preflight, but that function reads chemins_eSonde_v7.json, checklist_de_travail_eSonde_v7.json and sav_eSonde_v7_reference.json. It does not verify chemins_eSonde_v8.json, checklist_de_travail_eSonde_v8.json, the v8 error checklists or the v8 savepoint manifest. Thus the active interfaces rely on legacy control state rather than enforcing the v8 P0/P1/P2 phase gates. The GUI also omits the OASST1 v8 profile.
unresolved_critical_non_model_items.evidence: src/esonde_v7/preflight.py REQUIRED list; src/esonde_v7/cli.py; RUN_GUI.py lines invoking run_preflight; docs/V8_PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_STATUS.md
unresolved_critical_non_model_items.resolution: Implement one v8 preflight used by both interfaces; it must read the v8 paths/checklists and verify the current v8 savepoint manifest and immutable original checkpoint. Require phase-specific authorization and prove P0/P1 blocks generation in tests.
